verdict.rationale: The official CLI documents `skills list` (alias `ls`, "similar to `npm ls`") for listing installed skills and `skills remove` for removing them from specific agents (e.g. `npx skills remove --agent claude-code cursor my-skill`). The symlink-to-canonical-copy install model suggests removal can be centralized. Missing for 10: no documentation that removal deletes the canonical copy and all agent symlinks without leaving orphaned files, no evidence of lockfile cleanup or that no lingering instructions remain, and no hands-on or independent corroboration of clean uninstalls.
